title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - CityObject
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/CityObject. Generic class for describing city objects (e.g. a lamppost or a building). SAREF4CITY intends instances to typically be co-typed with a more specific domain extension (e.g. SAREF4ENVI for a lamppost, SAREF4BLDG for a building) that adds the object's own detailed properties; CityObject itself only contributes the generic identity and topology facets. Subclass of geo:Feature (http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature), from which it inherits the topology pattern used throughout SAREF4CITY: a geospatial position (mapped here to the standard NGSI-LD `location` GeoProperty, derived from geo:hasGeometry) and the geo:sfContains / geo:sfWithin containment relationships (e.g. a road segment feature containing a lamppost).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CityObject'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. GeoJSON reference to the item, derived from geo:hasGeometry. Point providing the geographical position of the city object.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

sfContains.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfContains'. Other geo:Feature entities spatially contained within this city object.

sfWithin.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfWithin'. The geo:Feature (e.g. a road segment or an AdministrativeArea) that this city object is spatially within.
